meta.name: caveman-commit
meta.description: Write a Conventional Commits message compressed to intent only. Use for "write a commit", "commit message", /commit or /caveman-commit.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 浓缩代码改动为一句提交信息
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常为提交信息措辞犯难,希望留下清晰记录。
copy.tagline_en: Condense code changes into one commit message
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often struggle with commit messages and want clean history.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会把你的改动写成一两条极简的提交消息：先写类型和简短摘要，只在有必要时才补正文解释“为什么”。它不实际运行提交，只把消息放在代码块里给你复制。
howto.when: 当你说“write a commit”、“commit message”，或用 /commit 等命令时触发。

say.text: 把这个改动生成 commit 消息
say.note: Claude 会将当前改动描述为提交稿。
直接唤醒该技能生成消息。

howto.what_en: Claude writes terse Conventional Commits messages: type, optional scope, short imperative summary; body only for why, breaking changes, etc. It never runs git commit—just prints a code block to paste.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say 'write a commit', 'commit message', or use /commit (or /caveman-commit).

say_en.note: Generates a concise Conventional Commits message.

say_en.text: Create the commit message for this change
